# scribe

> A small, standalone, shared speech-to-text web service. Apps send audio and get text back. Uses Groq whisper-large-v3-turbo first and OpenRouter Whisper as a backup, keeping cost under $0.10 per hour of audio. Used by Sparks (https://sparks.6x7.gr) for voice ideas.

## Pages
- / — Home and overview

## API
- POST /v1/transcribe — multipart `file` (audio, up to 25 MB) and optional `language`. Requires `Authorization: Bearer <app key>`. Returns JSON `{ text, language, durationSeconds, engine, costUsdEstimate }`. Keys are issued per app; there is no public key.

## Source
- https://github.com/philipposk/scribe (Next.js on Vercel)
